channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: What is the Mecca defence pact?
item.description: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan are activating their defence pact to counter attacks from Yemen’s Houthis.

item.title: At least 81 US aircraft worth up to $3.3bn lost or damaged in Iran war
item.description: The damage, documented in a Congressional Budget Office report, comes as Trump faces criticism over war's cost.

item.title: Hurricane Isaias charges towards the US Gulf Coast with dangerous winds
item.description: The storm is forecast to strike Florida, Alabama and Mississippi with up to 10 inches of rain this weekend.

item.title: Jerusalem Daily: Remembrance and mourning
item.description: Thousands protest worldwide in solidarity with Gaza as Palestinians mourn those being killed in daily Israeli strikes.

item.title: Dozens killed in Russian strike on civilian buses in eastern Ukraine
item.description: At least 33 people were killed after a Russian strike hit two civilian buses in a city within the Donestsk region.

item.title: Tanker hit by multiple projectiles in Gulf off Qatar, maritime agency says
item.description: Casualties have been reported on the vessel, identified by a maritime intelligence firm as the oil and chemical tanker, Acers.

item.title: Most UK diplomats to leave East Jerusalem consulate, Israel says, as Miliband says 'vital services' to remain
item.description: Israel said in September it would act in response to UK sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank.

item.title: Three people killed in Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia airports, officials say
item.description: The Houthis have claimed responsibility for the attacks, which mark an escalation in the conflict.

item.title: 'Every day there is killing': Palestinians in Gaza face Israeli strikes despite ceasefire as peace deal stalls
item.description: Many Palestinians are still living in cramped tent cities, with the US plan to end the war largely stalled.

item.title: Israelis demand accountability over 7 October failures three years after attacks
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has refused to take any personal responsibility for what happened or order a state inquiry.
